---
title: "Lectures"
subtitle: "Two lectures · one per volume · the whole course in four hours"
---

The course is delivered in two lectures, one per volume. Volume I poses the
General Enterprise Optimization Problem; Volume II solves it. Each lecture is
chapter-aligned — every slide carries its theorem numbers, so you can move
between the lecture, the chapter pages, and the text without losing your place.

## Lecture 1 — Volume I · Foundations and Mathematical Framework

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ucch8cXkId4 title="DCT Lecture 1 — Volume I: Foundations and Mathematical Framework" >}}

Builds the enterprise as a dynamic system: states, transformation operators,
deterministic and stochastic dynamics, and the four enterprise architectures —
culminating in the General Enterprise Optimization Problem.

## Lecture 2 — Volume II · Enterprise Optimization

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/wf3J4T9S11Q title="DCT Lecture 2 — Volume II: Enterprise Optimization" >}}

Works down the ladder of concessions — convexity, nonlinear conditions,
Pontryagin, dynamic programming, Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman, and distributionally
robust optimisation — asking of each rung what it buys and what it charges.
